description: Scaffold-only product slot for the Doganlab surface (innovation / R&D lab brand). Reserves the canonical product layout (mountPoint /products/doganlab, kebab-case productCode, dogan-consult ownership) so workspace + tsconfig path-alias regularity can be asserted across all products in Phase 7. No app/, no website/, no module enrollments yet — promotion to alpha requires a product-owner first commit (see README.md, section 'Promotion contract').

requiredArtifactsForAlpha: products/doganlab/app/  (Angular SPA scaffold or chosen UI framework)
Non-empty routeComposition.publicCompatPrefixes[] OR explicit decision to keep minimal
products/doganlab/agents/enrollment.json  (file referenced by agentEnrollment.enrollmentRef must exist)
promotionContract.enrollmentRefsNote: dynamicUiEnrollment.enrollmentRef and agentEnrollment.enrollmentRef point at files that do not yet exist on disk. The platform validator does not check enrollment file existence — only that the path strings are present (see scripts/validate-manifests.mjs). Enrollment files are required before the product can leave 'experimental'.
